Welcome to our school

Every child deserves room to shine.

At Shepherd Hands Academy, we believe education is about more than lessons and books. It is about helping children become curious learners, thoughtful friends and confident individuals.

Our aim is to provide a supportive learning environment where children can build knowledge, practise good values and discover their strengths.

What guides us

Growing minds and good hearts.

We want each child to feel encouraged to learn, supported as they grow and proud of the person they are becoming.
